title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
abstract: arXiv:2610.17856v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generation

translated_title: MMTA：基于时间序列、文本与视觉的多模态时间分析基准测试
translated_abstract: 时间序列分析越来越多地在多模态环境中被研究，然而大多数基准测试仅将时间信号与文本或从同一信号导出的可视化相配对。这使得多模态大语言模型能否将时间序列与真实世界的视觉证据相整合这一问题悬而未决。我们提出了MMTA（多模态时间分析），这是一个包含时间序列、文本和视觉三种模态任务的基准测试，具有多样化的跨模态互补性模式。MMTA涵盖九个领域——机器人、自动驾驶、人类动作、制造、AR辅助、医疗健康、推荐、金融和气候——采用视频+时间序列和图像+时间序列的布局，包含3,524个样本的测试集，涵盖分类和预测任务。该基准将异构的真实世界数据源标准化为统一的共享模式，提供领域特定的提示词、来源文档以及同时对错误答案和生成失败进行惩罚的成功加权评估指标。
tldr: MMTA是一个涵盖九个领域、融合时间序列、文本与视觉三种模态的多模态时间分析基准测试，首次系统评估了多模态大语言模型能否将时间序列与真实世界视觉证据相整合的能力。
en_tdlr: MMTA is a tri-modal benchmark spanning nine domains that systematically evaluates whether multimodal large language models can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence.
